name: every-step
description: One configuration among the many the sweep will visit, running every step this tree registers. It exists so that a chain longer than the reproduction chain is a profile rather than a code change, and its values are this repository's own rather than anybody's published ones.

drag_width.where: the width the synthetic generator digs its groove at, gutachten.synth.SurfaceParameters.drag_mark_width_um.
drag_width.confidence: exact for a generated surface, and a guess for any other. Nothing measures the width of a drag mark before this step is asked to mask it, which is the sequencing this project has not answered yet.

drag_position.where: where the generator puts the groove on a 256 row field sampled at 4 micrometres: (0.25 - 0.5) times 1024 micrometres, from gutachten.synth._drag_mark.
drag_position.confidence: exact on that field and wrong on a field of another size, because this parameter is a length from the centre and the generator's is a fraction of the extent.

drag_angle_deg.where: the generator's groove runs along the column axis, which is zero degrees in this step's convention.
drag_angle_deg.confidence: exact for a generated surface. A real drag mark's direction is a property of the mechanism and is not known before it is measured.

exclude_drag.where: excluding it is what the published chains do, and #57 is the issue that made this a setting rather than a fact. The other value is a reachable configuration and this profile is not the argument for either.
exclude_drag.confidence: this is the parameter the board exists to sweep, so a confidence here would be the answer the sweep has not produced.

extractor_radius.where: the disc used in tests/unit/transforms/test_marks.py, which is a construction rather than a measurement.
extractor_radius.confidence: none. The generator has no extractor mark, so no value here is checked against anything.

exclude_extractor.where: as exclude_drag: excluded in the published chains, and a setting here.

width.where: ten samples at a 4 micrometre sampling interval, chosen so that this configuration trims less than the reproduction chain does and the two profiles differ in something a reader can see.
width.confidence: none. It is a configuration, not a recommendation.

criterion.where: in from the boundary of the array, which is what a surface with no missing edge to grow from admits.
criterion.confidence: structural on a surface generated without edge dropout: "grow" measures out from what is already missing and there is nothing missing.

criterion.where: the robust of the two this step offers. gutachten.transforms.outliers says why the other one is inflated by the spikes it is being asked to find.
criterion.confidence: the argument for the criterion is in that module. What threshold it should carry is not settled by it.

threshold.where: five spreads, which is far enough out that the measurement noise of a generated surface does not reach it.
threshold.confidence: none. This is one of the parameters the sensitivity analysis exists to move.

neighbourhood.where: null takes the centre and the spread over the whole surface, which is the cheaper of the two routes the step offers.
neighbourhood.confidence: none. Which route is right depends on whether the surface's own form has been removed first, and here it has not.

model.where: the second order polynomial, chosen so this profile differs from the reproduction chain's plane in the form it removes.
model.confidence: none. Which form belongs on a primer face is a question the sweep is being built to answer.

order.where: the lowest order the polynomial model admits.

robust_tuning.where: null is an ordinary least squares fit, which is what this configuration differs from the reproduction chain by.
robust_tuning.confidence: none. What robustness is worth at this step is a sweep result.

robust_passes.where: null, because the two fields are set together and this fit is not robust.
robust_passes.confidence: structural. gutachten.transforms.level refuses one of the two without the other.

short_cutoff.where: the band docs/filtering.md measured this filter's transmission over in this tree.
short_cutoff.confidence: the transmission at these cutoffs is measured; that this band is the right one for a comparison is not.

robust_tuning.where: the constant docs/filtering.md measured the robust filter with, and what it costs at the short cutoff is a number in that file.
robust_tuning.confidence: the cost is measured. The value is a choice.
